propositions: Implement read-only metric derivations (attempts_per_ticket, first_pass_rate, rework_within_days, reopen_recovery, revert_recovery) over the durable ticket event store using RAW event files and compiled STATE where appropriate, reusing existing reducer helpers for file sorting and retired-event handling.

Metrics requiring per-event or multi-occurrence data (attempts, rework windows, reopen counts) must read raw event files sorted by event_sort_key with retired events included via is_active_event; metrics needing only terminal values (first_pass_rate, revert_recovery) read compiled reduce_ticket state.

An empty date range yields None (Unavailable in registry); a populated range with zero qualifying tickets or events yields measured zero (0); metrics register with source=structural and confidence=high.

Test coverage must verify: two distinct claimed_session values yield attempts_per_ticket==2; closed→open→closed 3 days apart is counted in rework_within_days(7) but not at 10 days; revert_recovery counts reverts targeting STATUS or COMMITS but excludes COMMENT reverts; retired events are included in all counts.
